entries.title: II Corinthians 2:1
segments: ¶But I determined this within myself, that I would not come again to you in sorrow.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:2
segments: For if I make you sorrowful, then who is he who makes me glad but the one who is made sorrowful by me?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:3
segments: And I wrote this very thing to you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow over those from whom I ought to have joy, having confidence in you all that my joy is [the joy] of you all.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:4
segments: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you, with many tears, not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have so abundantly for you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:5
segments: ¶But if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me, but all of you to some extent--not to be too severe.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:6
segments: This punishment which [was inflicted] by the majority [is] sufficient for such a man,

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:7
segments: so that, on the contrary, you [ought] rather to forgive and comfort [him], lest perhaps such a one be swallowed up with too much sorrow.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:8
segments: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm [your] love to him.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:9
segments: For to this end I also wrote, that I might put you to the test, whether you are obedient in all things.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:10
segments: Now whom you forgive anything, I also [forgive]. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:11
segments: lest Satan should take advantage of us; for we are not ignorant of his devices.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:12
segments: ¶Furthermore, when I came to Troas to [preach] Christ's gospel, and a door was opened to me by the Lord,

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:13
segments: I had no rest in my spirit, because I did not find Titus my brother; but taking my leave of them, I departed for Macedonia.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:14
segments: Now thanks [be] to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and through us diffuses the fragrance of His knowledge in every place.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:15
segments: For we are to God the fragrance of Christ among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing.

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:16
segments: To the one [we are] the aroma of death [leading] to death, and to the other the aroma of life [leading] to life. And who [is] sufficient for these things?

entries.title: II Corinthians 2:17
segments: For we are not, as so many, peddling the word of God; but as of sincerity, but as from God, we speak in the sight of God in Christ.
